    Profile

    Kuon is a highly gifted girl who performs rites in Wadatsumi. Due to her innocence and ignorance about the real world however, she ends up accepting anyone's behavior as virtuous. Whenever anyone tries to deceive her however, things always eventually end up well because luck is always on her side.

    Origin: Wadatsumi
    Gender: Female
    Height: 149cm
    Weight: 44kg
    Birthday: Jul 27
    Blood Type: Type Kn
    Zodiac: Moon of the Shimmering Dragon
    Likes: Food (sweets)
    Hobbies: Seeing people pound ricecakes
    Illust: ayi
    CV: 五十嵐裕美
